learning_outcomes.text: Students engage with various modern and future-oriented technologies and methods of digitalization in the context of product creation.

In the 'Digitalization in Product Development' course, central digitalization methods in the product creation process are taught – including Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), data-driven product development and manufacturing, the digital twin, and Extended Reality (XR).

In the CAE exercise, students have the opportunity to learn various computer-aided calculation methods and applications – for example, computer algebra systems, the Finite Element Method (FEM), and multibody simulations (MBS) – for solving constructive engineering tasks.

syllabus_topics: Digital product development and CAx methods
Extended Reality (XR) with a focus on Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR)
Approximation and model parameterization with MS Excel
Finite Element Method (FEM) and structural optimization with Creo Simulate

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (for Digitalization in Product Development)

assessment_rules: The processing of calculation tasks for the CAE exercise must be submitted as a graded lab report, which is recognized as an examination performance. For Digitalization in Product Development, there is a written exam lasting 60 minutes. The assessment performances for each subject are evaluated separately and with a 1:1 weighting.
bibliography: Randy H. Shih, Introduction to Finite Element Analysis Using Creo Simulate
Roger Toogood, Creo Simulate 8.0 Tutorial, Structure and Thermal
